leaves.name: javanpeykarPrinted
leaves.doc: javanpeykar-dict: Javanpeykar, Algebra Number Theory 8 (2014) Thm 1.1.1 in printed form, for X = X0 x_K Qbar with X0 a smooth proper geometrically connected curve over a number field K (Qbar = AlgebraicClosure K): Jac(X) as the degree-zero Picard scheme (V over K representing Pic^0_{X0/K} with the tensor group law, vendored Jacobian-Challenge library; V_Qbar = Jac(X)), g = dim H^1(X, O_X) the genus of X (genusBar), a Belyi map of X of degree d in function-field form (t in Qbar(X) with ramification index 1 at every place over a in A^1(Qbar) minus {0,1}, d = [Qbar(X) : Qbar(t)]), h = the published stable height of V: h <= 13*10^6 * g * d^5. Replaces javanpeykarBound together with belyiBaseChange; the Jacobian step (kernel IsJacobian = Pic^0, Milne 6.1 via the vendored Albanese property) and the genus step (dim J = genus of X_Qbar) are proved (JavanpeykarDict.abVarIso_picZero_of_isJacobian, isStableFaltingsHeight_of_iso, dim_eq_genusK, genusBar_eq).
leaves.flag: unread: new printed leaf (Javanpeykar 2014 Thm 1.1.1 at X = X0 x_K Qbar); Belyi map read in function-field form (curves over Qbar and their function fields); Jac(X) = Pic^0 representative over K (its base change represents Pic^0 of X); stable height of an abelian variety over Qbar read on a model over a number field
leaves.source: Javanpeykar, Polynomial bounds for Arakelov invariants of Belyi curves, Algebra Number Theory 8 (2014), Thm 1.1.1, p. 90 (arXiv:1403.6404v1 p. 1); height identification p. 98 (arXiv section 2.3 p. 9); read by the locator audit (docs/research/locators.md row R18)

leaves.name: belyiBaseChange
leaves.doc: javanpeykar-dict: glue (step 3 of the dictionary). For a smooth proper geometrically connected integral curve X over a number field K and a K-rational Belyi function t in K(X) (IsBelyiFunction K) of degree d = [K(X) : K(t)] > 0, the base change X_Qbar (Qbar = AlgebraicClosure K) is integral and has a Belyi function t' over Qbar (the image of t) of degree d. Standard: Qbar(X_Qbar) = K(X) (x)_K Qbar since X is geometrically integral (degree preserved), and a constant field extension is unramified (Stichtenoth, Algebraic Function Fields and Codes, Thm 3.6.3, number UNVERIFIED), so p(t) and then t - a stay uniformizers. Not proved: no Lean infrastructure for the function field of a base change.
leaves.source: javanpeykar-dict (proof outline in the docstring of JavanpeykarDict.BelyiBaseChange); Stichtenoth, Algebraic Function Fields and Codes, Thm 3.6.3 (constant field extensions are unramified), number UNVERIFIED
